patch_description:
This implementation uses a different hybrid strategy: smooth continuation is used only to discover promising contact graphs, explicit diameter-constrained SLSQP is used to sharpen those graphs, and a final batched exact-ratio basin polish accepts moves only when the evaluator’s actual squared ratio improves.

The final stage is deliberately based on the nonsmooth true objective rather than a surrogate. It proposes many centered, RMS-normalized tangent perturbations at once, evaluates the exact minimum-pairwise-distance squared divided by maximum-pairwise-distance squared, and adaptively shrinks the search radius when no strictly improving move exists. This helps resolve close contact changes that smooth soft-min formulations can leave slightly suboptimal.
